subtitle: What today's weather means for you
plannerHint: Coloured hours show when each applies
empty: Nothing special today — enjoy your day!

heat.title: Stay cool and drink water
heat.message: Feels like up to {{peak}} between {{start}} and {{end}}. Drink water often, even before you feel thirsty, and rest in the shade.
heat.why: Your body struggles to cool down when it feels hotter than 32°C, especially in humid air.

uv.title: Strong sun {{start}} – {{end}}
uv.message: UV index up to {{uv}}. Wear a hat, cover your skin and keep children in the shade.
uv.why: UV of 8 or more can burn skin and damage eyes in under 20 minutes.

airQuality.title: Unhealthy air today
airQuality.message: Air quality index {{aqi}}. People with asthma, children and older people should limit long outdoor activity.
airQuality.why: Fine particles from smoke, dust and traffic irritate the lungs when the index is above 100.

dust.title: Dusty air
dust.message: Cover your nose and mouth on busy or dusty roads, and keep food covered.
dust.why: Dust in the air is about {{dust}} µg/m³ — high enough to irritate eyes and lungs.

mosquito.title: Mosquitoes bite most after {{sunset}}
mosquito.message: Mosquito activity is {{level}}. Sleep under a treated net and cover arms and legs in the evening.
mosquito.why: Warm, humid weather after rain helps mosquitoes breed. Malaria mosquitoes bite mostly at night.

treatWater.title: Boil or treat drinking water
treatWater.message: Heavy rain can wash dirt into wells and taps. Boil or treat drinking water and wash hands with soap.
treatWater.why: About {{rain}} mm of rain fell recently — diseases like cholera spread more after heavy rain and floods.

coldNight.title: Cold night: {{low}}
coldNight.message: Keep babies, children and older people warm and dry tonight.
coldNight.why: Night temperatures this low are common in highland areas and are hard on the very young and old.

warmNight.title: Warm, humid night
warmNight.message: Let air flow through the room if it is safe, and drink water before bed.
warmNight.why: Tonight will not drop below {{low}}, so the body rests less well.

exercise.title: Best time to walk or exercise: {{time}}
exercise.message: The coolest dry hour {{day}}, with gentle sun.
exercise.why: Chosen from early morning and evening hours with no rain, the lowest 'feels like' temperature and low UV.

lightning.title: Lightning likely from {{time}}
lightning.message: Stay indoors during the storm, keep away from tall trees, open fields and water, and unplug electronics.
lightning.why: Thunderstorms are forecast. If you can hear thunder, lightning is close enough to strike.

wind.title: Strong winds up to {{gust}} km/h
wind.message: Secure iron roof sheets, doors, signboards and anything loose outside.
wind.why: Gusts above 50 km/h can lift loose roofing and break branches.

rainwater.title: Collect rainwater
rainwater.message: About {{mm}} mm of rain is expected from {{time}} {{day}}. Put out clean containers and clean your gutters.
rainwater.why: Every 1 mm of rain on 10 m² of roof gives about 10 litres — about {{litres}} litres from this rain.

solarGood.title: Great day for solar charging
solarGood.message: About {{hours}} hours of sunshine. Charge solar lamps, phones and power banks.
solarGood.why: Solar panels charge fastest in direct sunshine around midday.

solarLow.title: Little sun for solar today
solarLow.message: Only about {{hours}} hours of sunshine. Charge phones and lamps whenever you can and save power tonight.
solarLow.why: Thick clouds cut solar panel output a lot.

drying.title: Good drying {{day}}: {{start}} – {{end}}
drying.message: Hang clothes or spread crops out in this window.
drying.why: Dry, sunny and not too humid hours dry things fastest.

bestDay.title: Best day this week: {{weekday}}
bestDay.message: Good for outdoor plans like weddings, markets or travel — only {{rain}}% chance of rain.
bestDay.why: Picked from the next 6 days for the lowest rain and most comfortable temperature.

roads.title: Roads may flood or be muddy
roads.message: Plan extra travel time, never cross flooded roads or bridges, and drive or ride slowly.
roads.why: About {{mm}} mm of rain is expected — enough to flood drains and soften dirt roads.

fog.title: Fog from {{time}}
fog.message: Drive with lights on and keep extra distance.
fog.why: Fog is forecast, which can cut visibility to a few metres.

seasonSoon.title: {{season}} may start around {{date}}
seasonSoon.message: Get seeds and fields ready — the forecast shows enough rain to start the season.
seasonSoon.why: Season start = 20 mm of rain within 3 days, with no long dry spell after.

sprayOk.title: Good time to spray crops
sprayOk.message: Calm air and no rain expected for the next few hours.
sprayOk.why: Spray drifts in wind and washes off in rain; {{reason}} now.

moonDark.title: Dark moon nights
moonDark.message: Good nights for dagaa fishing with lamps.
moonDark.why: With little moonlight, fish gather more strongly around lamps.

moonBright.title: Bright moon nights
moonBright.message: Dagaa catches with lamps are usually lower around full moon.
moonBright.why: Bright moonlight spreads fish out instead of drawing them to lamps.

facts.humidity: Humid air makes sweat dry slowly, so it feels hotter than the thermometer says.
facts.thunder: If you can hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning. Go indoors.
facts.cloudyUv: Clouds do not block all UV — you can still get sunburnt on a cloudy day.
facts.rainLitres: 1 mm of rain on 1 m² of roof gives 1 litre of water. A 30 m² roof collects 300 litres from 10 mm of rain.
facts.mosquitoNight: Malaria mosquitoes bite mostly between late evening and early morning — nets matter most at night.
facts.altitude: Air cools about 6°C for every 1,000 m you climb — that is why Mbeya, Iringa and Arusha nights are cold.
facts.daylight: Being near the equator, Tanzania gets about 12 hours of daylight all year round.
facts.dewPoint: The dew point shows how much water is in the air: above 20°C feels sticky and humid.
facts.uvMidday: UV is strongest between 10:00 and 14:00 near the equator — even when it does not feel hot.
